about: Inputs of the Cosmos genealogy ingest. Paths are relative to --src (the unpacked upload). Order is precedence: on a contested single-valued fact the first source's value is accepted and every other value is kept as an alternative. family.ts leads because roths/cline_docs/systemPatterns.md names it the source of truth and roths3 (the latest build, 6 Jan 2026) loads it. The four Rothschild files are one source family (successive copies of one hand-made compilation, 5 Jan 2026 19:17 to 6 Jan 02:02 by mtime), so their agreement is not corroboration. curated/decisions.json comes first: it holds graded analyst decisions (model recall) that resolve error gates, and every value it overrides is kept.
grade_reason: Unattributed compilation inside the uploaded app: no citations, notes read as a model's paraphrase of Wikipedia (x3d.onto GLOSSARY: a model's paraphrase of a page is S). The record is transcribed exactly (sha256, locator, verbatim quote); the fact it states is Suspected until a tool checks it.

sources.role: graded analyst decisions that resolve error gates; first in precedence; every overridden value stays as an alternative
sources.grade_reason: Model recall by the analyst, not checked against a source (wikidata.org was refused by the egress proxy). Suspected until a tool confirms it.
